Class BleConnection

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.connection.ble.BleConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
MeshtasticConnection, TransportConnection
public class BleConnection extends Object implements MeshtasticConnection
BLE transport for Meshtastic and MeshCore Companion devices.

BLE operations are delegated to the platform-specific BlePlatform. Unlike TCP and Serial, Meshtastic BLE does not use serial framing; GATT characteristics carry protobuf payloads directly. MeshCore Companion carries its own binary BLE packets without the Meshtastic serial header.
